question: What is a dumb lie you told that completely spiraled out of control?
story: I pretended to be allergic to chocolate to avoid one slice of cake, and two years later my own wedding had a cheese tower instead. It started at a work potluck. A coworker named Dana brought a cake she had clearly worked on for days. It smelled like feet. I panicked and said I was allergic. She was so understanding that I could not take it back. Then she told everybody. HR put it in the office allergy binder. Every birthday after that, there was one sad lemon cupcake with my name on it, sitting alone on a plate. People thanked me for being brave. Then I dated Dana's brother for a year and ate zero chocolate. At Christmas his mother cried because she had made a flourless torte and had to throw the whole thing out. I am thirty one years old. I have never told a single person. I keep a Snickers in my glovebox.
